summary.en: Natural home-and-interior theme with forest green tones and soft pill shapes.
summary.fi: Luonnollinen koti- ja sisustusteema metsänvihrein sävyin ja pehmein muodoin.

profile.imageryStyle: Warm natural interiors, furniture in context and outdoor lifestyle; wide-aspect hero images.

purposes.hero: Browse hero — theme-curated background photograph, kicker, headline, supporting message, and one primary CTA.
purposes.product-list: Catalog grid — recent products so the range is visible immediately.
purposes.category-list: Category cards from the live catalog (categories.root when items are empty). Heading only — no extra button.
purposes.icons-with-text: Shopping-help strip — easy exploration, finding the right fit, guidance, and confident choice. Icon items, no section title, no imagery.
purposes.buttons: Contact closer — heading, short ask, and one empty-URL contact button.

purposes.hero: Compact overview hero — theme-curated background photograph, kicker, headline, and a category CTA.
purposes.category-list: Category cards from the live catalog (categories.root when items are empty).
purposes.product-list: Picks from every group — recent products already visible on the homepage.
purposes.icons-with-text: Shopping guidance — start by category, compare the options, and choose a favorite.

purposes.hero: Belief hero — why the store exists and two CTAs, over a background photograph (color band only if the theme has no hero image).
purposes.product-list: The whole range, not a single hero product.
purposes.text-colums-with-image: Editorial brand story — a portrait image, concise manifesto, and three supporting principles beside it. Button back to products.

purposes.hero: Launch hero — collection badge, headline and a collection CTA over a background photograph (color band only if the theme has no hero image).
purposes.product-list-with-tabs: Full release on one page — tabbed product grid (all / new / sale).
purposes.image-gallery: Lookbook — three portrait frames for collection mood. The first image is the personalization slot.
